summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (4.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥2,000M. Open-market acquisition on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Period: 3 August 2026 to 30 July 2027. Rationale: ROE target achievement and active shareholder return under medium-term plan UNISOL II.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief:
UNISOL Holdings announced on 31 July 2026 a share buyback program authorized by board resolution. The company will acquire up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares (4.2% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥2,000,000,000 via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 3 August 2026 and 30 July 2027.

The acquisition is framed as part of the company's medium-term plan UNISOL II, which identifies active balance-sheet management in service of ROE targets and flexible shareholder returns as a core strategic direction. The company intends to maintain self-equity capital at appropriate levels while executing discretionary shareholder distributions.

As of 31 March 2026, UNISOL Holdings held 252,530 treasury shares against an issued share count of 24,045,783 shares (excluding treasury).
